about: Claim back the VAT paid on building a new family home as a UAE national.
note: Requirements read from the official FTA service page on the checked date. FTA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. VAT refund for UAE nationals building a new home. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Applicant must be a UAE national
The building must be newly built and used only as the applicant's or family's home
Apply within 12 months of completion or occupancy
One application per residence, unless claiming retention payments or later additions with a new completion certificate
documents: Family sequence number if applying for someone else
Copy of the property completion certificate
Bank letter with IBAN if the refund goes to an international account
Notarised power of attorney or court authorisation, if applicable
Later on, the FTA may email for plans, permit, contracts, bill of quantities and tax invoices with payment proof
timing: About 15 minutes to apply on EmaraTax, about 3 minutes on the Maskan app
FTA processes a complete application in 25 working days
Retention payment claims within 6 months of payment
channels: Reply by email to the verification entity if more documents are asked for
